newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 1.4 pct Apr 11-20 -- CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 1.4 pct Apr 11-20 -- CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States fell 1.4 percent in the 10 days of April 11-20 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos decreased 2.3 percent, while U.S. sales of imports gained 4.5 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales fell 9.8 percent, to 171,235 from 189,851, CNW said. Domestic truck sales rose 6.4 percent, to 172,156 from 161,773, it said.
Import car sales advanced 4.9 percent at 46,251, and import truck sales rose 2.3 percent to 9,324, the report said.
Year-to-date vehicle sales in the United States reached 4,313,698, off 0.5 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
